items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 91:1
items.html: Since AA and Atik became one Partzuf, the NHY of AA are found in the place of the NHY of Atik, namely in the place of his own HGT, and the HGT of AA are in the place of the HGT of Atik, namely in his own GAR. (Page 920, Item 87).
